title: MRE 102 - Marine Engineering Systems and Practice

items.q: Which statement correctly defines ram type steering gear?
o: a machine that moves liquid by giving it energy
the list of parts and quantities for a system or assembly
the drawing showing where blocks must be placed to support the hull
steering machinery in which hydraulic rams move the rudder stock
items.s: ram type steering gear: steering machinery in which hydraulic rams move the rudder stock. The other options describe docking plan, pump, bill of materials.
